> **Do not attach private data.** Do not attach laboratory images, results, or files that contain research data or
> credentials.

## Problem

What task is hard or impossible today? Describe the situation in words.

## Proposed change

What should the app do? Describe the behaviour, not the code.

## Effect on the researcher's review

Does the change alter what the researcher sees, approves, or exports? If so, say how.

## Effect on counts or scientific claims

Does the change alter default parameters, detection, or any result that is reported? If so, say what evidence would be
needed to justify it. See the scientific claims policy in [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/oriamos/poco/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
